title: Sanitize Wix snapshot and remove extension artifacts
decision: The migration pipeline strips Wix runtime scripts, extension-injected fragments, and consent-banner runtime wrappers from the captured source before generating project artifacts.
context: Captured HTML included runtime noise and browser-extension contamination that should not ship in source-controlled outputs.
implementation: scripts/migrate-snapshot.mjs removes script/noscript nodes and consent banner root.
Only known media extensions are copied from source asset folder to static/assets.
Asset URLs are rewritten from snapshot-relative paths to /assets/ runtime paths.
consequences: Lower risk of shipping third-party extension markup/scripts.
